verdict.rationale: 1Password Service Accounts and Connect Servers support scoped, vault-limited, short-lived credentials for machine/agent workflows, and the Environments MCP Server explicitly avoids returning secrets to the agent, which aligns with least-privilege agent access. However, evidence doesn't show fine-grained per-agent scoping controls, credential rotation/expiry specifics, or audit tooling tailored to AI agents specifically (vs generic machine/service workflows). missing for 10: documentation of granular per-agent permission scoping, credential lifecycle/expiry controls for agents, and independent/hands-on verification of least-privilege enforcement in agent contexts.
